27:t_2:27.en:
$$恵理$$
「...All right. But first, you need to move up a grade. Work hard in your remedial classes.」

27:t_2:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes...! The entire Volunteer Club intends to tackle them as one.」

27:t_2:29.en:
$$恵理$$
「We can take our time thinking about what comes after graduation. See you...」

27:t_2:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「What is it, $$千鳥$$? You have the same look on your face as Miss $$神楽坂$$.」

27:t_2:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「'Future plans' means... what you'll do after you graduate.」

27:t_2:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「I do not know what lies that far ahead.」

27:t_2:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「So I decided to treasure what is right in front of me.」

27:t_2:37.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes. Graduating from $$陣代高校$$ with the Volunteer Club and my classmates in Class 2-4.」

27:t_2:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「Along with fighting the $$新地球皇国$$, that is something I must cherish.」

27:t_2:40.en:
$$宗介$$
「Of course, $$千鳥$$... You will be with us too.」

27:t_2:41.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Wh-what... You make it sound like you only just remembered.」

27:t_2:42.en:
$$宗介$$
「Your face is red. Have you caught a cold?」

27:t_2:43.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...You haven't changed in that respect, either.」

27:t_2:45.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then it's a promise. Let's make sure we graduate together.」

27:t_2:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「Including my promise to show you the sea, that makes two promises now.」

27:t_2:49.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then those two promises... You'd better keep them.」

27:t_2:52.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Spying on people isn't very classy, $n.」

27:t_2:53.en:
$n
「I can't get between those two right now.」

27:t_2:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Nothing. Well... my student teaching ends soon, so I'd better work hard too.」

27:t_2:58.en:
$n
(This strange anxiety that's been clinging to my mind... Does Miss $$スズネ$$ feel it too...?)

27:t_2:59.en:
$n
(What is this feeling...? Fear of the $$新地球皇国$$? Or fear of the $$レイライン$$s going out of control...?)

27:t_2:62.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hurry up and get $$宗介$$. $$マオ$$ is treating us to ramen. Let's go before she changes her mind.」

27:t_2:63.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm telling you now, you're having yours without garlic.」

27:t_2:64.en:
$n
「Why? Galaxy Ramen wouldn't be the same without a boiled egg and garlic, right?」

27:t_2:65.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Are you sure? You're going to see the Nurse afterward.」

27:t_2:66.en:
$n
「...What if I drink milk? Would that work?」

27:t_2:67.en:
$$クラン$$
「Of course it wouldn't! What do you think a reunion between lovers is supposed to be!?」

27:t_2:68.en:
$$クラン$$
「There are far too many men in this unit who don't understand how women feel!」

27:t_2:70.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$クラン$$ is right, $n. You need to learn more about women.」

27:t_2:71.en:
$n
「$$ミシェル$$... I'm taking the heat for what you did...」

27:t_2:73.en:
$n
「N-no...! Nothing that would add fuel to the fire!」

27:t_2:74.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hehe... It's good manners before seeing a woman. I don't have plans to meet anyone, so I'm putting in plenty.」

27:t_2:75.en:
$n
「Isn't that kind of bragging... a little sad?」

27:t_2:76.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Not at all! I'll work hard and live my life even if I'm on my own.」

27:t_2:77.en:
$n
「...I give up. I'll follow your example, Miss $$スズネ$$, and stay positive too.」

27:t_2:79.en:
$$スズネ$$
(That's right, $n... Don't let yourself lose...)

27:t_2:80.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Not to this anxiety... or to fate...)

27:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, $$宗介$$. Your defeat of the $$ベヘモス$$ was splendid.」

27:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, its weakness was clear from your battle in $$お台場$$, so that big brute must have been an easy win for you.」

27:t_10:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「...That weakness had been completely corrected.」

27:t_10:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I initially aimed for its crotch too, but extra armor had been added there. Brute force is the only way to defeat it.」

27:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But you were really fired up today, $$宗介$$. You've improved at using the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$'s power to attack, too.」

27:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your heightened mental state produced 100Z in Z-Chips. I'll add them to the unit's reserves.」

27:t_10:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're still a chip miser rather than a money miser...」

27:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! They are what I must protect!」

27:t_10:18.en:
$$アル$$
「Reception is clear. There are no issues with communication.」

27:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have obtained the items you requested. I'll come install them later.」

27:t_10:20.en:
$$アル$$
「Thank you. The $$新地球皇国$$ has disrupted 《$$ＵＮ$$》 connections, so the information I can obtain is limited.」

27:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand wanting a dictionary and news of world affairs, but a slang dictionary, movies, and anime too...?」

27:t_10:22.en:
$$アル$$
「The Sergeant told me my vocabulary is limited and my thinking is rigid. They are necessary to overcome those weaknesses.」

27:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You want to leave $$宗介$$ eating his words, then. In that case, I, $$ＡＧ$$, will help you.」

27:t_10:24.en:
$$アル$$
「Instructional message. Please define 'eating his words.'」

27:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please learn that yourself. For now, I'll prepare information on subjects he has trouble with.」

27:t_10:26.en:
$$アル$$
「What subjects does the Sergeant have trouble with?」

27:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Romance and humor, to be precise. Let us master those fields, $$アル$$.」

27:t_10:28.en:
$$アル$$
「Thank you. Are you helping me out of a sense of fellowship with another artificial intelligence?」

27:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, no... I have great expectations for you, $$アル$$.」

27:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. When that day comes, I'll collect payment for my assistance.」
